description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Bartz (Wind)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Master of Wind (0~2), removed after using Master of Wind two times

description.name: Master of Wind Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Master of Wind level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Bartz (Wind)]

description.name: Master of Wind Level
description.text: Keeps track of Master of Wind level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Bartz (Wind)]
